content:
A video short highlights Apple’s playful use of James Bond homages in its keynote opening, with shots directly emulating ones from Skyfall …

Filmmaker Todd Vaziri had previously drawn attention to the heavy influence of a Mission Impossible movie on Apple’s 2018 event intro. This time he points to the very direct use of Skyfall shots in the introduction video to this year’s event.

He posted a video short to YouTube directly comparing the two.

It was a good spot, and a fun touch by Apple.
